heading.en: The tissue that holds you together

hook.en: Bones, the fat under your skin, the cartilage in your ear and even your blood are all connective tissues. What could they possibly have in common?
hook.kn: ಮೂಳೆ, ಚರ್ಮದಡಿಯ ಕೊಬ್ಬು, ಕಿವಿಯ ಮೃದ್ವಸ್ಥಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಕ್ತ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳು. ಇವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವೇನು?

objectives.en: State the general features of connective tissue
Distinguish loose, dense and specialised connective tissues

narration.en: Bones, the fat under your skin, the cartilage in your ear and even your blood are all connective tissues. What could they possibly have in common?
narration.kn: ಮೂಳೆ, ಚರ್ಮದಡಿಯ ಕೊಬ್ಬು, ಕಿವಿಯ ಮೃದ್ವಸ್ಥಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಕ್ತ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳು. ಇವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವೇನು?

title.en: General features and loose connective tissue

body.en: Connective tissues are the most abundant and widely distributed tissues in complex animals; they link and support other tissues. In all of them except blood, the cells secrete fibres of the structural proteins collagen or elastin, and also modified polysaccharides that form the matrix or ground substance. Loose connective tissue has cells and fibres loosely arranged in a semi-fluid ground substance. Areolar tissue under the skin contains fibroblasts that make fibres, macrophages and mast cells. Adipose tissue, also below the skin, stores fat.
body.kn: ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹರಡಿರುವ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ; ಇತರ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ರಕ್ತ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಉಳಿದವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಲಾಜನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಎಲಾಸ್ಟಿನ್ ನಾರುಗಳು. ಸಡಿಲ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ: ಏರಿಯೋಲಾರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಬ್ಬಿನ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ.

points.en: Fibres: collagen or elastin (not in blood)

narration.en: Connective tissues are the most abundant and widely distributed tissues in complex animals; they link and support other tissues. In all of them except blood, the cells secrete fibres of the structural proteins collagen or elastin, and also modified polysaccharides that form the matrix or ground substance. Loose connective tissue has cells and fibres loosely arranged in a semi-fluid ground substance.
narration.kn: ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹರಡಿರುವ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ; ಇತರ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ರಕ್ತ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಉಳಿದವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಲಾಜನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಎಲಾಸ್ಟಿನ್ ನಾರುಗಳು. ಸಡಿಲ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ: ಏರಿಯೋಲಾರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಬ್ಬಿನ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ.

body.en: In dense connective tissue the fibres and fibroblasts are compactly packed. In dense regular tissue the collagen fibres run in parallel rows: tendons attach skeletal muscle to bone, and ligaments attach one bone to another. In dense irregular tissue, found in the skin, fibres are oriented in different directions.
body.kn: ಸಾಂದ್ರ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರುಗಳು ಒತ್ತಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಣೆ. ಸ್ನಾಯುರಜ್ಜು (ಟೆಂಡನ್) ಸ್ನಾಯುವನ್ನು ಮೂಳೆಗೆ, ಅಸ್ಥಿರಜ್ಜು (ಲಿಗಮೆಂಟ್) ಮೂಳೆಯನ್ನು ಮೂಳೆಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: In dense connective tissue the fibres and fibroblasts are compactly packed. In dense regular tissue the collagen fibres run in parallel rows: tendons attach skeletal muscle to bone, and ligaments attach one bone to another. In dense irregular tissue, found in the skin, fibres are oriented in different directions.
narration.kn: ಸಾಂದ್ರ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರುಗಳು ಒತ್ತಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಣೆ. ಸ್ನಾಯುರಜ್ಜು (ಟೆಂಡನ್) ಸ್ನಾಯುವನ್ನು ಮೂಳೆಗೆ, ಅಸ್ಥಿರಜ್ಜು (ಲಿಗಮೆಂಟ್) ಮೂಳೆಯನ್ನು ಮೂಳೆಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Cartilage has a solid, pliable matrix that resists compression; its cells, chondrocytes, sit in small cavities. In adults it is found at the tip of the nose, the outer ear, between bones of the vertebral column, and in limbs and hands. Bone has a hard, non-pliable matrix rich in calcium salts and collagen; its cells, osteocytes, lie in spaces called lacunae. Long bones support weight and bone marrow makes blood cells. Blood is a fluid connective tissue of plasma, red blood cells, white blood cells and platelets.
body.kn: ಮೃದ್ವಸ್ಥಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಂಡ್ರೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು; ಮೂಗಿನ ತುದಿ, ಕಿವಿ. ಮೂಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಲವಣ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಲಾಜನ್; ಆಸ್ಟಿಯೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಲ್ಯಾಕುನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ. ರಕ್ತ ದ್ರವ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ.

points.en: Bone: osteocytes in lacunae, calcium salts

problem.en: A sprinter tears the tissue joining her calf muscle to her heel bone, while a footballer injures the tissue joining his thigh bone to his shin bone at the knee. Name each tissue and its type.

steps.en: Muscle to bone is joined by a tendon.
Bone to bone is joined by a ligament.
Both are dense regular connective tissue, with collagen fibres in parallel rows.

answer.en: Sprinter: tendon; footballer: ligament; both dense regular connective tissue

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A sprinter tears the tissue joining her calf muscle to her heel bone, while a footballer injures the tissue joining his thigh bone to his shin bone at the knee. Name each tissue and its type.

body.en: Tendon: muscle To bone. Ligament: Links bone to bone.

narration.en: Tendon or ligament? Tendon: muscle To bone. Ligament: Links bone to bone.

mnemonic.en: T for muscle-To-bone, L for Linking bones

points.en: Connective tissue links and supports; it is the most widespread tissue.
Areolar and adipose are loose; tendons and ligaments are dense regular.
points.kn: ಏರಿಯೋಲಾರ್, ಕೊಬ್ಬು ಸಡಿಲ; ಟೆಂಡನ್, ಲಿಗಮೆಂಟ್ ಸಾಂದ್ರ ನಿಯಮಿತ.

points.en: Cartilage, bone and blood are specialised connective tissues.
points.kn: ಮೃದ್ವಸ್ಥಿ, ಮೂಳೆ, ರಕ್ತ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳು.

points.en: Blood has no fibres; it is fluid connective tissue.

homework.en: Draw areolar tissue and label fibroblast, macrophage, mast cell, collagen and elastin fibres.

narration.en: Recap. Connective tissue links and supports; it is the most widespread tissue. Areolar and adipose are loose; tendons and ligaments are dense regular. Cartilage, bone and blood are specialised connective tissues. Blood has no fibres; it is fluid connective tissue.
